rd.badMedia: The video did not come from your computer. The view was closed.
rd.body: See the computer's screen here, and use it with touch or as a touchpad. The person at the computer answers each request.
rd.lockedBody: Input is paused until someone unlocks it at the computer.
rd.mode.touchHelp: Touch mode: tap to click, hold for a right click, drag to drag.
